# Geometry fixtures

`brain-tangent-fill.json` contains 13 cubic paths produced by the line-tracing mode on the repository's `app/starter-brain.png`, in its original 1536 × 1024 coordinates. It is a reduced regression for the narrow cerebellum-side region and adjacent brainstem region. The tiny parallel links share an initial tangent; input-order sorting used to join both faces. Keep the original control points, including the very short links.
